description: This Java source file defines the ContentPagesController class, a Spring MVC controller managing CRUD operations and auxiliary functions for Content entities of type PAGE within an admin web interface for a sales management application.

classes.name: ContentPagesController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling administration of content pages, including listing, creating, viewing, deleting, and saving content entries, with role-based authorization.

methods.name: listContentPages
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all content pages, setting up menu context.

methods.name: createPage
methods.description: Handles GET requests to initialize creation of a new content page, setting default descriptions for all store languages.

methods.name: getContentDetails
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch and display details for a specific Content entity by ID, with validation.

methods.name: removeContent
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a Content entity by ID, returning JSON success or failure response.

methods.name: pageStaticContent
methods.description: Handles POST requests to retrieve a list of Content entities of specified type (PAGE or BOX) for display, returning JSON.

methods.name: saveContent
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update a Content entity; validates role permissions and form data.

methods.name: checkContentCode
methods.description: Handles POST requests to verify the uniqueness of a content code within the store, preventing duplicates.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper to set up navigation menu context for the views.
